description: Hitachi SHC 5.1 Release 8 (compiler passes; assembler and linker from 5.0 Release 31). 'game' is the option set Sega's Katana tool manual (read_1st.txt, 1998) requires of every application, plus -optimize=1 and -fpu=single, which supersedes the manual's -double=float; -extra=a=400 is the undocumented SH7091 workaround that puts a nop after every mov Rm,r0. 'library' is the same without that workaround: Sega's own libraries, above 0x0c1e9000 in the image, were built without it. A unit names its set with "options"; the default is game.
